Blitz.name: Blitz
Blitz.description: Spending the appropriate martial points to activate Bleed, Blinding Attack, Crippling Attack, and Throw causes every successful strike made with a knife to apply these specialization effects.

skillStats.description: Spending the appropriate martial points to activate Bleed, Blinding Attack, Crippling Attack, and Throw causes every successful strike made with a knife to apply these specialization effects.

Assassination.name: Assassination
Assassination.description: The character uses their altered strike to inflict 1d10 piercing damage per rank. The damage dice rolled is doubled if the character has at least one placed roll on the attack or if the target of the attack is adjacent to at least one of their opponents.

skillStats.description: The character uses their altered strike to inflict 1d10 piercing damage per rank.
skillStats.alternateDescription: The character uses their altered strike to inflict 2d10 piercing damage per rank.
skillStats.condition: If the character has at least one placed roll on the attack or if the target of the attack is adjacent to at least one of their opponents.

Bleed.name: Bleed
Bleed.description: The next successful strike this turn prevents the target from recovering any HP until the end of their next turn.

skillStats.description: The next successful strike this turn prevents the target from recovering any HP until the end of their next turn.

Blinding Attack.name: Blinding Attack
Blinding Attack.description: The next successful strike this turn blinds the target until the end of their next turn.

Blinded.name: Blinded
Blinded.description:
Target cannot utilize its sight to perceive its surroundings, and has their LOS restricted to 10’. The target automatically fails any checks that require sight.
True blindness prevents all means of sight, even those  provided by magical or unnatural senses. Magical darkness inflicts True Blindness, limiting LOS to touch.
The affected target suffers 2 displaced rolls on all PER checks.
All attack rolls against the target gain a placed roll.

skillStats.description: The next successful strike this turn blinds the target until the end of their next turn.

Crippling Attack.name: Crippling Attack
Crippling Attack.description: The next successful strike this turn causes the target to lose functionality of a limb, AGI or STR save (target's choice) to negate. Should all of the targets' means of mobility be crippled, they no longer have access to movement DVs. The target must recover any amount of HP for the limb to function again.

Crippled.name: Crippled

Throw.name: Throw
Throw.description: The character uses their altered strike to throw their weapon 30' per rank without a might or acrobatics check.

Lethal Barrage II.name: Lethal Barrage II
Lethal Barrage II.description: For every rank purchased, the character adds 2 damage to all successful strikes this turn.
